violations.text: Dumpster area observed with an accumulation of trash, litter, and/or other debris. Refuse area must be kept clean as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the (kitchen near frying station ) do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2026

Inspector observed sponges in the handwashing sink and employee rinsing a bowl in sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing.PIC informed. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026
Handwashing sink in the kitchen is lacking signage. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (icing) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026

(Chemical) was stored with food, equipment, utensils, or single service items. Chemicals must be stored to prevent the contamination of clean equipment, utensils linens, and/or single service by spacing or partitioning and locating them in an area that is not above food, equipment utensils, linens, and single service articles. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026

The presence of (rodents ) is not controlled as evidenced by (droppings throughout kitchen area ). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026
Establishment is using non food grade containers for food storage. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of debris: -proofer -bakers rack -prep table shelves -equipment shelves -mixer platform -glazing table shelves -2 dr reach in Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025

A hose is connected to the faucet at the (handsink ). This faucet is lacking a backflow prevention device. An approved backflow prevention device is required in order to prevent backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply at each point of use at a food establishment. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026
Dumpster observed with an accumulation of trash, litter, and/or other debris. Refuse area must be kept clean as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (dining room and kitchen ) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025

The floors throughout kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was proper handwashing sign. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025

Working containers of ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025
Inspector observed food stored in non-food grade containers. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025
The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -deep freezer chest, -floor mixer, -2 door cooler. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025
Inspector observed second faucet head missing for 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 05/01/2025
The door to the bathroom is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 05/01/2025

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the dining area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or nonfunctional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 05/01/2025

Raw animal foods (such as eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as cake crumbles and cream) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Eggs relocated during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/31/2024
